 """Database lookup helpers."""
+
+
+def find_orders(connection, orders, request):
+    """Return matching IDs; callers handle database failures."""
+    from sqlalchemy import select
+
+    statement = select(orders.c.id).where(orders.c.owner == request.args["owner"])
+    return connection.execute(statement).fetchall()
